approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Photorealistic video. Use @car as the exact vehicle reference: preserve the silver-blue Bugatti's distinctive body shape, horseshoe grille, dark windows, wheels and paint. Use @bridge as the location reference: the Golden Gate Bridge with its red suspension towers, cables, roadway and blue bay in clear daylight. One continuous tracking shot of this Bugatti driving forward smoothly in a traffic lane across the Golden Gate Bridge. Camera tracks alongside and slightly ahead at a front three-quarter angle, keeping the whole car visible while the bridge towers and suspension cables pass naturally in the background. Realistic wheel rotation, consistent car proportions, natural reflections and grounded tire contact. The car is on the bridge roadway, not the pedestrian walkway. No exhibition platform or crowd from the car reference. Silent; no text overlays.
